name: asmtools: a plate with two holes, a cover whose second hole is 0.3 off, two pins; an assembly with the pin mated in the first hole
asmtools: hole alignment: the first holes line up, the second pair is 0.3 off; the result window lists it
asmtools: clearance verification: plate and cover touch (0); the pin has 0.1 radial clearance in both holes; touching left out; the chosen pin only against the rest
asmtools: replace: pick the pin, choose the long pin in the PropertyManager, OK — the mates are found again
asmtools: copy with mates: concentric to a new reference (the plate's second hole, picked), the face mate repeated
asmtools: envelope: the cover becomes an envelope (see-through, out of the BOM and mass); select inside it
asmtools: undo takes the envelope back, then the copy
